dg-APL-252375.title: Lifegard Quiet One PRO 100 (37 GPH)
dg-APL-252375.summary: A tiny, very quiet Lifegard Quiet One PRO pump (about 37 GPH) for nano returns, reactors and other jobs that need steady low flow; best run submerged.
rows: Valve on the pre-filter grill (submersible use)

dg-APL-209034.title: Lifegard Quiet One PRO 400 (103 GPH)
dg-APL-209034.summary: A quiet Lifegard Quiet One PRO pump (about 103 GPH) with internal recirculation to keep it cool and clear debris, for small returns, reactors and general water moving; best run submerged.
rows: Valve on the pre-filter grill (submersible use)

dg-APL-252367.title: Lifegard 25 Watt Pre-Set Quartz Glass Heater
dg-APL-252367.summary: A 25 W Lifegard quartz-glass heater that comes pre-set to 78°F, so there is nothing to adjust; for fresh or saltwater tanks up to about 10 gallons.

dg-APL-211117.title: Lifegard Turbo Media Reactor Side Flow Nano
dg-APL-211117.summary: A compact Lifegard side-flow media reactor for tanks up to about 75 gallons that tumbles biopellets or holds carbon, GFO and similar media, with built-in flow control and a Quiet One 400 pump included.
inBox: 1x Nano Side Flow Turbo Media Reactor

dg-APL-211119.title: Lifegard Turbo Media Reactor Side Flow Large
dg-APL-211119.summary: The large Lifegard side-flow media reactor for tanks up to about 250 gallons, for biopellets, carbon, GFO and similar media, with built-in flow control and a Quiet One 1200 pump included.
inBox: 1x Large Side Flow Turbo Media Reactor

dg-lifegard-airline-bulkhead-kit.title: Lifegard Airline Bulkhead Kit
dg-lifegard-airline-bulkhead-kit.summary: A complete kit for bringing air in through the bottom or side wall of a tank, so airline tubing stays hidden. Hook it to an air pump to run an air stone or air-driven ornament.
rows: 1 1/2 in (drill it or order the tank pre-drilled)
Any air pump; drives air stones and air-powered ornaments
inBox: Airline bulkhead with gasket and lock nut
